notes.title: First Update - EX and More!
notes.content: [p]Hey everybody,[/p][p][/p][p]The first major update for Touhou Picross is out![/p][p][/p][p]The main attraction is the EX stage, continuing the story and challenging players with ten new puzzles.[/p][p][/p][p]I've also added the following:[/p][list][*][p]Puzzle completion statistics on the save file selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]A music room with my comments on each track[/p][/*][*][p]Five new standalone puzzles[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]I hope you all enjoy the new content![/p]

notes.title: Update Notes for August 5, 2024
notes.content:
Just a couple touch-ups in the Workshop:

[/list]
